name: SQRT
description: Returns the square root of a non-negative number.

examples.title: Square root
examples.description: Square root of a stored value
examples.sql: SELECT SQRT(squared_distance) as dist FROM points

notes: Arithmetic is not accepted inside a scalar function argument: compute the value into a column, or apply the arithmetic outside the call
distance is an accepted spelling of ST_DISTANCE and is therefore rejected as an alias
